title: .config/coupled-tags.toml, version 1
description: A repository's settings for its COUPLED markers, for coupled-tags-lint, which reads the copy on disk in the directory it scans. See coupled-tags-lint's README.

version.description: The version of this file's format.

exclude.description: Path prefixes, from the repository's root, whose markers aren't checked, such as examples and test fixtures.

registry.description: The registry's path from the repository's root, with no `.` or `..` part, so it's inside the repository.

tag-relations.description: Whether each marker's label is followed by its site's relations, as seen from it, so any reader sees what must hold where the value is edited. --fix writes or drops them.

tag-pointer.description: Whether each marker's label is followed by a message saying what to search for to find the group's sites and which file describes the group, for a reader who doesn't know the convention. It comes after the relations, if they're on. --fix writes or drops it.
